sourceContract: Codex CLI hook JSON protocol (SessionStart) carrying the payload-stated codex_version, model, and session source
author: otel-hook integration owner (agent)
sanitization: Session id, turn ids, and working directory are invented placeholders; codex_version is a deliberately non-real sentinel ('0.42.0-fixture') so a test can prove the version came from the payload and not from a codex binary on the host PATH.
notes: Anchors the client-version-attribution dimension: our adapter reads codex_version from the payload, while the pinned reference ignores it and shells out to `codex --version` (DIVERGENCE-010).
